Ivy N.: flagging a small but consistent mismatch in invoice-preview for token accounting around routing failovers. preview shows ~1.4% extra tokens on affected tenants (route=llm-chat, routing_policy=latency-first)
Samir K.: any idea if it's double-count or misattribution to route variants?
Ivy N.: dug into tallies and saw pairs of events with same request fingerprint written by two different writers within 2-4s of each other. looks like a race during router reissue on transient errors
Diane P.: oof. did we recently change router retry/backoff behavior?
Samir K.: yes, last week's change reduced retry backoff floor from 500ms -> 100ms to improve latency. suspect: retries + fanout reordering cause duplicate writes before dedupe fires
MeteringBot: alert: cross-shard-duplicates +15% in last 2h https://console/redwood/metering/alerts/2048
Ivy N.: concrete example (sanitized): ```req_id=r-9f2 route=llm-chat primary_shard=s-7 write_ts=2026-02-11T09:12:02Z; duplicate_shard=s-21 write_ts=2026-02-11T09:12:05Z fingerprint=fp-4be```
Diane P.: if fingerprinting happens in the writer after shard selection, we lose the chance to suppress duplicates earlier. two options: move fingerprint extraction into router pre-fanout, or expand cross-shard dedupe window in writer
Kenji H.: moving fingerprint to router sounds right but touches router hot path. expanding dedupe-window is lower-risk but increases KV cache usage. what's our capacity headroom?
Samir K.: estimate: +6% memory if window=5s across writers. previews show it holds for small tenant cohorts. tradeoff: short-term toggle vs long-term router change
Ivy N.: proposal: 1) short-term preview-only feature flag `preview_dedupe_cross_shard_secs=5` scoped to 5 tenants, 2) instrument traces with `fp_pre_router` and `writer.fp_seen` to validate, 3) wire a dashboard card "dup-induced-token-adjustments" in invoice-preview UI
Diane P.: also add a small alert when writer_kv_cache_evictions/s > 3 so SRE can rollback quickly if memory spikes
MeteringBot: task created: MTR-1610 preview dedupe-window + router fingerprint traces  assigned to Kenji H.  due 2026-02-14
Kenji H.: i'll start with the preview flag path and add metric emission. router change will be a follow-up RFC since it affects the hot path
Samir K.: make sure previews include a diff card that shows per-tenant delta and a small histogram of per-request duplicate latency gaps. product will want to see impact per-customer
Ivy N.: agreed. Diane, can you add the invoice-preview card? i'll coordinate with Product/Billing for a short note in the preview UI explaining this is an operational mitigation, not a billing change yet
Diane P.: on it. will add a line in the preview header and a new card called "duplicates prevented (preview)" with counts and percent impact
OpsBot: deploybot: preview-flag toggled for tenants [t-101,t-202,t-303,t-404,t-505] by Kenji H.
Kenji H.: flipped canary. running diffs now. PR WIP for metric traces and dedupe-window toggle. adding unit tests for eviction thresholds
Ivy N.: (after) preview diffs: average delta across sample tenants 0.28%, max 0.9% for one tenant. writer_evictions rose 0.6%. looks within tolerances for preview. next: schedule a controlled rollout to all previews and open RFC for router pre-fingerprint migration. :white_check_mark:
